desc.zh: 下单请求的命令对象，由请求体反序列化而来。
desc.en: Command object for placing an order, deserialized from the request body.

desc.zh: 订单的对外视图，仅暴露展示所需字段。
desc.en: External view of an order, exposing only display fields.

desc.zh: 订单实体，映射 orders 表，含乐观锁版本。
desc.en: Order entity mapped to the orders table, with an optimistic-lock version.

desc.zh: 发往支付网关的扣款请求。
desc.en: Charge request sent to the payment gateway.

desc.zh: 支付网关返回的扣款结果。
desc.en: Charge result returned by the payment gateway.

desc.zh: 订单检索的条件对象。
desc.en: Criteria object for order search.

desc.zh: 订单创建完成后的领域事件。
desc.en: Domain event fired after an order is created.

desc.zh: 订单搜索文档，映射 orders 索引；由订单事件异步写入。
desc.en: Order search document mapped to the orders index; written asynchronously from order events.

fields.zh: 商品/收货人冗余检索字段

desc.zh: 面向 C 端用户的移动客户端：下单、查单并实时追踪订单状态。
desc.en: Mobile client for consumers: place orders, query orders and track status in real time.

desc.zh: 运营管理台：订单检索、退款操作与经营数据看板。
desc.en: Operations console: order search, refunds and business dashboards.

desc.zh: 订单模块 REST 入口：接收下单与查询请求，委派 OrderService 处理并返回视图对象。
desc.en: REST entry point of the order module: accepts create/query requests, delegates to OrderService and returns view objects.

desc.zh: 提交订单：校验命令对象后创建订单，返回订单视图。
desc.en: Submit an order: validates the command object, creates the order and returns the view.

desc.zh: 查询单个订单详情，按订单号加载。
desc.en: Load a single order detail by order number.

desc.zh: 按条件分页查询订单。
desc.en: Search orders by condition with pagination.

desc.zh: 订单领域业务契约：定义下单、检索与状态流转的对外接口。
desc.en: Order domain contract: public APIs for placing, searching and transitioning orders.

desc.zh: 创建并持久化订单，随后发起支付并广播订单事件。
desc.en: Creates and persists the order, then initiates payment and publishes the order event.

desc.zh: 按主键加载订单。
desc.en: Load an order by primary key.

desc.zh: 组合条件分页检索订单。
desc.en: Search orders by combined conditions with pagination.

desc.zh: OrderService 默认实现：编排仓储、支付与事件推送；写路径带事务与幂等保护。
desc.en: Default OrderService implementation: orchestrates repository, payment and event publishing; the write path is guarded by transactions and idempotency.

desc.zh: 校验并落库新订单，随后发起支付扣款（携带幂等键）并广播订单创建事件。
desc.en: Validates and persists the new order, then charges payment (with an idempotency key) and broadcasts the OrderCreated event.

desc.zh: 查订单详情：先读 Redis 缓存，未命中回源 JPA；对账场景走 MyBatis-Plus 直查主库。
desc.en: Order detail: reads the Redis cache first, falls back to JPA; reconciliation paths query the primary DB via MyBatis-Plus.

desc.zh: 订单检索：组合条件走 XML 动态 SQL，运营分页列表走 MyBatis-Plus Wrapper。
desc.en: Order search: combined conditions go through XML dynamic SQL; the paged operations list goes through a MyBatis-Plus Wrapper.

desc.zh: 订单链路的横切关注点：方法级审计日志与仓储写入指标，按切点织入业务流程（不改动业务代码）。
desc.en: Cross-cutting concerns of the order flow: method-level audit logging and repository write metrics, woven in by pointcuts without touching business code.

desc.zh: 环绕业务层全部公开方法：记录入参、出参与耗时，写入审计日志。
desc.en: Around all public service methods: logs arguments, results and duration to the audit log.

desc.zh: 仓储保存成功后采集订单写入指标。
desc.en: Collects order write metrics after a successful repository save.

desc.zh: 领域对象与视图对象的转换器（MapStruct 生成实现）。
desc.en: Converter between domain and view objects (MapStruct-generated implementation).

desc.zh: 将订单实体转换为对外视图，隐藏审计与乐观锁字段。
desc.en: Converts the order entity to the external view, hiding audit and optimistic-lock fields.

desc.zh: 订单实体的 Spring Data 仓储：派生查询与持久化。
desc.en: Spring Data repository for the Order entity: derived queries and persistence.

desc.zh: 新增或合并保存订单实体。
desc.en: Inserts or merges the order entity.

desc.zh: 按主键查找订单。
desc.en: Find an order by primary key.

desc.zh: 订单复杂查询的 MyBatis 接口：语句实现在同名 XML 映射文件中（见「绑定」连线）。
desc.en: MyBatis mapper interface for complex order queries: statements live in the XML mapping file with the same name (see the bind edge).

desc.zh: 按组合条件检索订单，SQL 见 XML 映射文件。
desc.en: Searches orders by combined conditions; SQL lives in the XML mapping file.

desc.zh: 统计当日订单量，SQL 见 XML 映射文件。
desc.en: Counts today's orders; SQL lives in the XML mapping file.

desc.zh: 与 OrderQueryMapper 接口同命名空间绑定的 SQL 映射文件：点击右侧 SQL 查看完整拼接语句。
desc.en: SQL mapping file bound to the OrderQueryMapper interface namespace: click SQL on the right to see the fully assembled statement.

items.name: selectByCondition

desc.zh: 动态 SQL：按状态 / 时间 / 用户组合条件检索订单并 LIMIT 限流（全部条件拼接后的完整形态）。
desc.en: Dynamic SQL: searches orders by status / time / user conditions with a LIMIT (full form with every condition applied).

items.sql:
SELECT id, user_id, status, amount, version
  FROM orders
 WHERE status = ?
   AND user_id = ?
   AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ?
 ORDER BY created_at DESC
 LIMIT ?

items.name: countTodayOrders

desc.zh: 聚合统计当日订单量。
desc.en: Aggregated count of today's orders.

items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM orders
 WHERE created_at >= ?
   AND created_at < ?

tagline.zh: MyBatis-Plus 接口 · 内置 CRUD

desc.zh: 继承 BaseMapper<Order> 的 MyBatis-Plus 接口：SQL 由实体注解与 Wrapper 在接口内直接生成，不走 XML；点击行上「SQL」查看实际执行的完整语句。
desc.en: MyBatis-Plus interface extending BaseMapper<Order>: SQL is generated inline from entity annotations and Wrappers, no XML; click SQL on the row to see what is actually executed.

items.name: selectById

desc.zh: MyBatis-Plus 按主键查订单：列名取 @TableField 映射，逻辑删除追加 deleted = 0。
desc.en: MyBatis-Plus primary-key lookup on orders: columns come from @TableField mapping; logical delete appends deleted = 0.

items.sql:
SELECT id, user_id, status, amount, version
  FROM orders
 WHERE id = ?
   AND deleted = 0

items.name: selectPage

desc.zh: MyBatis-Plus 分页检索：Wrapper 链式条件按全部命中展开，分页插件追加 LIMIT。
desc.en: MyBatis-Plus paged search: Wrapper chain expanded with all conditions hit; the pagination plugin appends LIMIT.

items.sql:
SELECT id, user_id, status, amount, version
  FROM orders
 WHERE status = ?
   AND deleted = 0
 ORDER BY created_at DESC
 LIMIT ?, ?

desc.zh: 维护 /topic/orders 的 WebSocket 会话，把订单状态变化实时推送给前端。
desc.en: Maintains WebSocket sessions on /topic/orders and pushes order status changes to the frontend in real time.

desc.zh: 向订阅 /topic/orders 的在线会话广播订单事件。
desc.en: Broadcasts order events to online sessions subscribed to /topic/orders.

desc.zh: 封装支付服务的 HTTP 访问：超时控制、重试与熔断。
desc.en: HTTP access to the payment service: timeout control, retries and circuit breaking.

desc.zh: 发起扣款请求：超时 3s，失败自动重试 2 次，幂等键防重复扣款。
desc.en: Sends the charge request: 3s timeout, 2 automatic retries, idempotency key prevents double charges.

desc.zh: 数据源连接配置（节选自 application.yml）。
desc.en: Datasource connection settings (excerpt from application.yml).

desc.zh: 支付客户端的自定义配置段（节选自 application.yml）。
desc.en: Custom configuration for the payment client (excerpt from application.yml).

desc.zh: 订单库：orders 表由 JPA 实体映射生成，统计查询走手写 SQL。
desc.en: Order database: the orders table is generated from the JPA entity mapping; statistics queries use hand-written SQL.

tagline.zh: 支付服务 · 内部集群

desc.zh: 内部支付微服务：负责扣款、退款与对账。
desc.en: Internal payment microservice: charges, refunds and reconciliation.

desc.zh: 前端订阅的订单事件主题，经 WS 网关广播。
desc.en: Order event topic subscribed to by the frontend, broadcast via the WS gateway.

desc.zh: 订单详情缓存与秒杀库存锁；命中缓存可跳过一次 DB 查询。
desc.en: Order detail cache and flash-sale stock locks; a cache hit skips one DB query.

desc.zh: 订单详情缓存：未命中回源 DB 并以 10 分钟 TTL 写回。
desc.en: Order detail cache: on miss, falls back to the DB and writes back with a 10-minute TTL.

desc.zh: 秒杀库存锁，看门狗续期，锁失败直接拒单。
desc.en: Flash-sale stock lock with watchdog renewal; failure rejects the order outright.

desc.zh: 当日销量排行，供管理端热销榜。
desc.en: Today's sales ranking for the admin best-seller board.

desc.zh: 承载订单域事件的生产与消费，消费失败重试 3 次后进入死信队列。
desc.en: Carries production and consumption of order domain events; failed messages retry 3 times then land in the dead-letter topic.

desc.zh: 订单创建事件；消费组 order-svc。
desc.en: OrderCreatedEvent; consumer group order-svc.

desc.zh: 死信队列，人工处理。
desc.en: Dead-letter topic for manual handling.

desc.zh: 支付网关回调事件。
desc.en: Payment gateway callback events.

desc.zh: orders 业务索引供前台检索；order-audit 接收 Logstash 汇入的审计日志。
desc.en: The orders index serves frontend search; order-audit receives audit logs shipped by Logstash.

desc.zh: 订单检索索引，由事件监听异步写入。
desc.en: Order search index, written asynchronously by the event listener.

desc.zh: Logstash 汇入的应用审计日志。
desc.en: Application audit logs shipped in by Logstash.

desc.zh: 存放电子发票 PDF 等业务文件；访问凭证已脱敏。
desc.en: Stores business files such as e-invoice PDFs; access credentials are masked.

desc.zh: 消费 order-events：写入搜索索引并触发电子发票生成。
desc.en: Consumes order-events: writes the search index and triggers e-invoice generation.

desc.zh: 消费订单创建事件：写 ES 索引、生成发票上传 OSS，并转发通知交换机。
desc.en: Consumes OrderCreatedEvent: indexes into ES, generates the invoice to OSS, and forwards to the notification exchange.

desc.zh: 渲染电子发票 PDF 并经 OSS SDK 上传，返回签名访问 URL。
desc.en: Renders e-invoice PDFs and uploads them via the OSS SDK, returning a signed access URL.

desc.zh: 按事件生成发票 PDF，putObject 到 demo-bucket/invoice/ 目录。
desc.en: Generates the invoice PDF from the event and putObjects to demo-bucket/invoice/.

desc.zh: LogstashTcpSocketAppender：日志编码为 JSON 后经 TCP 发往 Logstash。
desc.en: LogstashTcpSocketAppender: logs are encoded as JSON and shipped to Logstash over TCP.

desc.zh: 接收应用 JSON 日志流，补全字段后 bulk 写入 Elasticsearch。
desc.en: Receives the application JSON log stream, enriches fields and bulk-indexes into Elasticsearch.

desc.zh: 运营与研发查看订单审计日志仪表盘与错误率大盘。
desc.en: Operations and dev teams view order audit dashboards and error-rate boards.

desc.zh: Redis 连接与连接池配置（节选自 application.yml）。
desc.en: Redis connection and pool settings (excerpt from application.yml).

desc.zh: 订单通知的 Direct 交换机：按路由键 order.created 分发到短信与邮件队列。
desc.en: Direct exchange for order notifications: routes by key order.created to the SMS and email queues.

desc.zh: 订单创建通知：绑定 notify.sms 与 notify.email。
desc.en: Order-created notifications: binds notify.sms and notify.email.

desc.zh: 短信通知队列：消费方渲染模板后调用短信网关。
desc.en: SMS notification queue: consumers render templates and call the SMS gateway.

desc.zh: 邮件通知队列：消费方渲染 HTML 模板后调用邮件服务。
desc.en: Email notification queue: consumers render HTML templates and call the mail service.

desc.zh: 消费短信队列：渲染通知模板并调用短信网关，失败重回队列。
desc.en: Consumes the SMS queue: renders notification templates and calls the SMS gateway; failures requeue.

desc.zh: 渲染短信模板并调用网关发送。
desc.en: Renders the SMS template and sends it via the gateway.

desc.zh: 消费邮件队列：渲染 HTML 模板并投递邮件。
desc.en: Consumes the email queue: renders HTML templates and delivers emails.

desc.zh: 渲染 HTML 邮件并投递。
desc.en: Renders the HTML email and delivers it.
